people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

translations.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.
translations.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father David had done. He did everything as his father Joash had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
translations.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, yet not like David his father: he did according to all that Joash his father had done.
